name: IRS - Federal individual income tax balance due (Direct Pay / Online Account)
why: Federal income tax: every U.S. filer; the IRS payment site is the most-used government billing site. Chosen over the separate IRS payment-plan and estimated-tax records (same irs.gov billing site) and EFTPS (business-oriented).

name: California Franchise Tax Board (FTB) - personal income tax
why: Largest state income tax population (~39M residents); Web Pay and MyFTB.

name: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance (personal income tax)
why: ~19.5M residents; also collects NYC and Yonkers resident tax (those records share this billing site and are not picked separately).

name: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue (personal income tax)
why: ~13M residents; myPATH portal.

name: Illinois Department of Revenue (IDOR) - individual income tax
why: ~12.5M residents; MyTax Illinois portal.

name: Ohio Department of Taxation (individual and school district income tax)
why: ~11.8M residents; OH|TAX eServices; distinctive rules (no payment plans at the agency, no phone payments).

name: Georgia Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
why: ~11M residents; Georgia Tax Center (GTC) with Quick Payment.

name: Michigan Department of Treasury (individual income tax)
why: ~10M residents; MiTreasury eServices Citizen portal.

name: Virginia Tax (Virginia Department of Taxation) - individual income tax
why: ~8.7M residents; online services account, QuickPay and Teleplan payment plans.

name: Indiana Department of Revenue (DOR) - individual income tax
why: ~6.9M residents; INTIME portal. Picked over North Carolina (NCDOR has no individual online account, which the dedicated tier requires), Massachusetts and others whose public pages could not be read.

name: Comptroller of Maryland (individual income tax)
why: ~6.2M residents; Maryland Tax Connect (live Sept 2026) with pay-without-registering and online payment plans.

name: Missouri Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
why: ~6.2M residents; MyTax Missouri with guest individual payments, User ID accounts and online Internet Installment Agreements. Replaced Oklahoma (smaller, and its OkTAP sign-in, guest pay and AutoPay rules could not be confirmed on public pages; its dossier stays as an extra).

name: Wisconsin Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
why: ~5.9M residents; My Tax Account and Quick Pay; online payment plans ($20 fee).

name: Colorado Department of Revenue - Taxation (individual income tax)
why: ~5.9M residents; Revenue Online with no-login Make a Payment and payment plan requests.

name: Minnesota Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
why: ~5.7M residents; e-Services individual accounts and Payment Plan Agreement System.

name: South Carolina Department of Revenue (SCDOR) - individual income tax
why: ~5.4M residents; MyDORWAY (free card/ACH, scheduling up to 13 months, Payment Plan Agreements).

name: Alabama Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
why: ~5.1M residents; My Alabama Taxes with Pay a Bill and IIT payment plans.

name: Oregon Department of Revenue (personal income tax)
why: ~4.2M residents; Revenue Online with payment plans and automatic plan ACH.

name: Connecticut Department of Revenue Services (DRS) - individual income tax
why: ~3.6M residents; myconneCT (ACH scheduled up to 45 days; payment plans offline).

name: Utah State Tax Commission (individual income tax)
why: ~3.4M residents; Taxpayer Access Point (TAP) with payment agreements and pay by phone. North Carolina has no individual online account; New Jersey, Arizona and Kentucky showed none on their public pages and Massachusetts pages were blocked.
